SELECT FROM cms_tag t
AND t.status = #{status}
AND t.tag_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND t.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cms_article_tag link INNER JOIN cms_article a ON a.id = link.article_id WHERE link.tag_id = t.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.visibility = 'ALL' )
ORDER BY t.tag_name ASC, t.id ASC
SELECT FROM cms_tag t WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cms_article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{id})
